name: Ghaziabad Nagar Nigam
headquarters: Navyug Market, opposite Old Bus Stand, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh 201001
description: Municipal corporation for Ghaziabad city, upgraded from a Municipal Board on 31 August 1994. Its 100 wards are grouped into five administrative zones. This archive excludes Ghaziabad Development Authority and the district's other urban local bodies.
